content.text: {"prompt":"Create an original cute chibi-style desktop mascot inspired by John Wick. Depict a small full-body Q-version man with a serious but adorable expression, neat black medium-length hair, a short trimmed beard, and a sleek black suit with black tie and white shirt. Make him look like a stylish action hero in a simplified, toy-like desk-pet style, with a large head, small body, and slightly oversized hands and shoes. He can hold a simple pencil or stand with hands at his sides to keep the design office-friendly and suitable as a desktop companion. Clean polished digital illustration, high detail, soft shading, appealing proportions, and a simple light background that keeps focus on the character. Make the result charming, collectible, and suitable as a desktop pet/avatar.","aspect_ratio":"1:1"}

parts: Model caption: A clean studio-like illustration scene on a plain light/white background with subtle shading at the feet, featuring a single chibi / stylized cartoon human character standing center. Overall: a cute, highly rendered 3D/illustration chibi figure (large head, small body) in a minimal background, front-facing, slightly dramatic lighting, high-detail shading, polished digital art. Human subject: a male-looking adult (appears Caucasian/white or light-to-olive complexion, with a stylized “Keanu Reeves/John Wick” inspired look) in chibi form: very large head, tiny body, big glossy brown/dark eyes, intense/serious/focused facial expression with furrowed brows and a slightly angry/stoic look, small blush/cheek shading, and a short scruffy beard and mustache (dark). Hair: medium-to-long black/dark hair, slightly wavy, parted near the center/with strands falling around the face, glossy highlights, with hair reaching around the ears and neck in a tousled style. Face: large expressive eyes, thick dark eyebrows, small nose, subtle cheek marks or light scars/lines near the face, and a neatly trimmed dark beard/mustache and stubble/chin beard area. Pose and gesture: standing upright, feet apart, confident/stern stance; one hand (left or right depending on view—he is holding in his right hand from our perspective) is holding a pencil-like object vertically/at an angle, while the other hand is in his pocket (relaxed yet cool stance). The pencil: a black pencil (graphite pencil look) with a sharpened tip; the character grips it in a small chibi hand, the pencil is fairly large relative to the hand, with a pointed graphite tip at the top and a dark body. Clothing: a formal black suit (fitted blazer/jacket and matching trousers), white dress shirt, black tie, and a black vest or suit layering visible (a three-piece suit look), with a pocket detail (pocket square or pocket line) and a belt buckle; black dress shoes that are shiny and oversized in chibi proportions, with laces and a polished appearance; one hand tucked into the pocket of the pants/jacket, the other holding the pencil. Accessories/details: belt buckle visible, suit buttons, crisp collar and tie; very neat “assassin/sleek agent” vibe reminiscent of John Wick styling but in chibi form. Style: cute chibi/figurine-like character design with high-detail rendering, soft shading, smooth gradients, warm brown eyes with bright highlights, and a slightly cartoon-3D/illustrated look. Background: plain white to off-white with subtle ground shadow beneath the feet for anchoring, no other objects or people. Overall composition: centered full-body chibi character, clean minimal background, strong character focus, studio lighting and polished illustration/vinyl-figure look.<|has_watermark|>

{"prompt":"Create a polished character sheet / desktop-pet sprite-style illustration for an original mascot named "John Weak". Image A is the style and identity anchor: use it as the basis for the character’s appearance and overall vibe. Keep the same chibi proportions, black medium-long hair, trimmed beard, black suit, white shirt, black tie, and cute-but-serious expression inspired by a stylish assassin archetype, but present him as an original mascot called John Weak. Make him slightly more playful and approachable for use as a desktop pet. 

The final image should contain multiple separated full-body pose variations of the same character on a pure solid white background with no gradient and no scene elements, so the poses are easy to extract individually. Arrange the poses cleanly like a sprite sheet / model sheet in a neat grid, with generous spacing between poses. No background decoration, no shadows beyond minimal subtle grounding if needed, and keep the white background uniform.

Include 8 distinct poses/states of the same chibi character: 
1) idle front-facing standing, 
2) waving hello, 
3) walking left, 
4) walking right, 
5) running left, 
6) running right, 
7) sitting/resting, 
8) a cool confident pose holding a pencil like a signature prop.

All poses must look like the same consistent character design, suitable for making a desktop pet. Make the style high-quality, cute, crisp, polished digital illustration, easy to cut out, with clean outlines and clear silhouette separation. parts: Model caption: A clean white background sprite-sheet / character sheet style illustration, overall scene: a grid-like arrangement of 8 chibi / super-deformed cartoon character poses of the same man, evenly spaced with lots of white space, as if meant for stickers or assets. The human subject: a single adult-looking light-to-medium-skinned/white or ambiguous-ethnicity (or olive-toned) male with a chibi proportions (large head, small body), dark brown/black long hair shoulder-length and parted/middle with loose strands, thick dark eyebrows, big dark brown eyes, a short full beard and mustache stubble/trimmed beard, looking serious/cute and confident; appears in multiple poses and facial expressions (mostly neutral/serious and friendly), wearing a formal black suit (black jacket, black pants), a black vest/waistcoat under the jacket, a white dress shirt and a black tie, black belt, black dress shoes/polished shoes, and a pocket square or pocket detail on the jacket. He sometimes has one hand in pocket and often holds or gestures; overall style is glossy, highly rendered chibi/illustration with strong outlines, shading, highlights, and a cute anime-ish look. Top row (left to right): 1) Standing front-facing pose: arms relaxed with one hand in pocket, serious/neutral expression, chibi stance, full black suit and shoes (hands by side/one in pocket). 2) Waving pose: front-facing with right hand raised palm open in a friendly wave, left hand in pocket, similar face with slightly softer look. 3) Walking/striding left profile-ish (or facing left): body turned sideways left with determined look, one leg forward and one back, arms bent as if mid-step, hair flowing slightly back. 4) Walking/striding right profile-ish (facing right): similar to previous mirrored, mid-step to the right with arms bent and hair swept, serious expression. Bottom row (left to right): 5) Running to the left: dynamic running pose, hair swept back dramatically, brows furrowed/angry-determined look, one arm pumping forward with fist, legs in running stride, suit jacket flaring. 6) Running to the right: dynamic running pose in the opposite direction, similar hair motion and intense expression, suit jacket flowing, fists/arms pumping. 7) Sitting pose: chibi version seated on the ground with legs bent/splayed slightly, hands resting near sides, calm or slightly pouty serious expression, front-facing, suit and shoes visible. 8) Cool pose with pencil: standing with a confident attitude, holding a pencil (black/graphite-looking pencil with sharpened tip) upright in one hand like a prop, other hand in pocket, slightly angled/stern/confident face, suit and polished shoes. Overall colors: predominantly black suit and hair, white shirt, warm tan/peach skin tone, dark brown eyes, subtle highlights in hair and clothing, clean white background, no text, arranged in two rows (four figures per row) like a character sticker sheet.<|has_watermark|>
